name: reset-password
title: Reset password
description: The last screen of a manga 'forgot password' flow, made only with mangacn. A manga Panel shows a reader drawn whole in SVG (ink lines, paper fills, a screentone jacket) holding up a big key, focus SpeedLines around her, 'キラッ' Sfx lettering and a SpeechBubble that reacts: 'A fresh start.', a shout bubble 'Huh?!' on error, 'Yes!' on success. From 48rem of container width the panel sits on the start side at the full height of the form; under it the panel is a 4:3 picture above the form. The form, in a case (G1) when there is room: a new password in an InputGroup with a show/hide toggle (aria-pressed, 'Show password' / 'Hide password', touch-hit, it reveals both fields) and a PasswordStrength gauge, a confirmation Input, a Save Button with its loading state. Field errors (empty, weak when the score is under 2, mismatch) appear on submit with focus on the first wrong field; the demo 'server' refuses the current password 'Lanterns42!' with the G8 error box (accent fill, edge-jagged, '!' mark, shake, role=alert). Success: the 'Saved!' Stamp lands and 'Back to sign in' calls onNavigate. One column on phones with 44px touch targets; container queries widen it. Works in light, dark, any accent and with Radix or Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/reset-password". The root fills its container width; the panel and the form sit side by side once the block is 48rem wide. Replace the simulated timeout in save() with your own call (and drop the CURRENT demo check); passwordScore from password-strength decides 'weak' locally. Pass onNavigate to wire 'Back to sign in' to your router.

meta.tagline: A new password with a strength gauge, then a 'Saved!' stamp.
meta.usage:
import { ResetPassword } from "@/components/manga/blocks/reset-password"

<ResetPassword email="mika@inkwell.app" onNavigate={(screen) => router.push(`/${screen}`)} />

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called by 'Back to sign in' after the password is saved. Without it the button does nothing.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and placement of the whole interface.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: The title's heading level: "h1" when the block is the page, "h2" inside a page that already has its h1.
